objective: Replace the structured-text-only Pie, Radar, QuadrantChart, and Venn outputs with genuine deterministic terminal chart geometry. Implement mermansi-native bounded Canvas geometry without modifying or forking merman-core, merman-ascii, Selkie, or any parser. Pie must draw a closed circular/radial chart with visible sector boundaries or proportional sector fill derived from every finite nonnegative section value, plus a compact legend preserving every label, value, percentage, title, and showData semantics; a bar/table alone is not acceptable. Radar must draw a shared center, radial axis spokes, graticule rings or polygons, and connected plotted curve vertices normalized from configured min/max while preserving every axis label, curve label/value, ticks, graticule choice, showLegend, and title. QuadrantChart must draw a closed Cartesian plotting area with midpoint cross-axes, all four quadrant labels in their actual regions, endpoint axis labels, and every point placed from its normalized x/y coordinates with deterministic collision-safe markers/callouts; preserve class and style metadata without pretending terminal color is geometry. Venn must draw closed overlapping set outlines for the semantic singleton sets, place intersection/subset and text labels in or connect them to their associated regions, preserve sizes, labels, styles, and arbitrary parsed subsets, and remain genuine geometry rather than a Subsets/Text Nodes list. For every family preserve Complete-mode canonical models, Concise-mode chart geometry with no structured-text fallback, ASCII and Unicode geometry, Chinese/CJK display widths, ANSI-independent geometry, determinism, control sanitization, and typed width/height/cell/byte/entity limits before allocations. Add strong tests for shape closure, proportional/coordinate placement, axis/spoke/curve connectivity, overlap identity, collision handling, empty/zero/invalid constructed models, bilingual fixtures, narrow widths, ASCII, determinism, and bounds. Update AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md honestly. Apply KISS, YAGNI, DRY, and SOLID: reuse only minimal chart primitives that are genuinely shared.

steps.description: Replace centroid-only Venn labels with a small SetCircle/RegionLabel layout: ellipse membership checks, deterministic candidate ordering, exact-region preference, and occupied display-span checks.

Place every subset and text-node label inside its region when possible; otherwise place a marker in the region and connect it to a collision-free right-side callout. Preserve existing size/style summaries.
Size the Venn canvas from set count and crop unused outer whitespace while respecting checked dimensions and CJK display widths.

Add exact integration and private geometry tests for collision-free labels, visible text-node identity, region membership, connectors, compactness, ASCII/Unicode, and determinism; run focused and full verification.

implementation.summary: Replaced centroid overwrites with deterministic ellipse-aware region placement. Labels reserve complete display spans with padding; overflow labels receive in-region markers, short leaders, and a monotonic right-side callout lane. Text-node identities now appear in geometry/callouts, unused canvas margins are cropped, singleton size ratios remain encoded, and metadata summaries remain intact.

verification.summary: The exact Unicode/ASCII collision, region-association, compactness, and determinism test passed; private membership/crop tests passed; cargo fmt --check, clippy with -D warnings, and all-target/all-feature tests passed. 206 tests passed with zero failures. Manual fixture inspection confirmed the original merged-label defect is gone and geometry fell from about 49 to about 20 rows.

summary: Current Codex diff and rendered-output review found no actionable defects for Issue #0004. Every normal parsed subset/text node is either placed on a fully membership-checked free span or represented by a membership-checked marker and keyed callout; callout rows preserve anchor order, labels cannot overwrite one another, CJK widths use display columns, and output remains bounded/deterministic. The implementation stays local to the Venn adapter (KISS/SRP) and reuses existing chart primitives (DRY).

resolutions.description: Acceptance met by collision-free membership-aware label placement, connected keyed callouts, cropped compact geometry, exact structural tests, visual inspection, and clean full verification.
